title: Wrongful Dismissal Claim Requests Refused by Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management
what_it_is: Wrongful Dismissal Claim Requests Refused by Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management

sections.label: Wrongful dismissal claim filing deadline
sections.summary: Under the Employment Claims Act, wrongful dismissal claims must be filed within one month from the last day of employment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Under the Employment Claims Act (ECA), wrongful dismissal claims must be filed within one month from the last day of employment.

sections.label: Late filings and TADM assessment
sections.summary: About 60 employees yearly, or 6% of those seeking TADM mediation for wrongful dismissal, exceeded the filing time limit; TADM assesses timely claims using the Tripartite Guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Each year, about 60 employees, or 6% of those seeking TADM mediation services for wrongful dismissal claims, exceeded the time limit for filing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For claims within the time limit, TADM assesses the facts of each claim based on the Tripartite Guidelines on Wrongful Dismissal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If TADM assesses the case to be unsubstantiated, it explains to the claimant the reasons and does not continue with the mediation process.

sections.label: Cases referred to ECT
sections.summary: About 130 cases each year, or 12% of all wrongful dismissal claims, were referred to the ECT in this way.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: About 130 cases each year, or 12% of all wrongful dismissal claims, were referred to the ECT in this way.

sections.label: TADM mediator training
sections.summary: All TADM mediators undergo training by the Singapore Mediation Centre, in addition to in-house training on the law and dispute resolution process.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In addition to robust in-house training on the law and the dispute resolution process, all TADM mediators undergo training by the Singapore Mediation Centre.

sections.label: Untracked voluntary cases and evidence
sections.summary: Voluntary assisted cases are not tracked, and insufficient evidence in wrongful dismissal usually involves contractual terms as the reason for termination.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The answer is, we do not track the cases that are assisted on a voluntary basis.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In terms of the evidence where the wrongful dismissal does not have sufficient evidence, usually, as I have said, it is due to cases where the contractual terms are the reason for the termination and the claimant cannot substantiate sufficient evidence.
